statement: For every complete finite simple SRG(99,14,1,2), let R count actual induced rook-nine vertex sets once and put d_T=6-r_T. Suppose R=226, every d_T belongs to {0,1,2,3}, exactly two actual deficiency-three triangles occur and are disjoint, and b counts actual deficiency-two triangles. Then b is not two.
assumptions: R=226 counts actual induced rook-nine vertex sets once
d_T=6-r_T belongs to {0,1,2,3} for every actual triangle
exactly two actual d3 triangles, pairwise disjoint

scope.description: Conditional exclusion of disjoint c2/b2 at R226/maxd3, separate from the intersecting-high branch.

exact_case_coverage.h0_weighted_bound: q<=4-4t, q>0 since each Qw coordinate has fractional part2/3

limitations: The explicit D3-disjointness hypothesis is not inferred by this branch.

No complete two-d3, R226 or target exclusion, realization, automorphism or equitability is claimed.
